summary: This bill requires most health plans to cover all stages of breast and chest wall reconstruction, including various modalities, types, and procedures, as well as related surgeries, prostheses, and complication treatments, for individuals undergoing breast cancer treatment.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates that group health plans and health insurance issuers provide coverage for various breast and chest wall reconstruction services related to breast cancer treatment. This expands the scope of required coverage within the private healthcare system, making it more comprehensive for specific medical needs.

The bill's sole purpose is to mandate that group health plans and insurers cover an expanded set of breast reconstruction services and related care following cancer treatment, directly imposing government requirements on coverage. This is a clear instance of government action to expand mandated benefits rather than relying on market competition.
